structural.note: Fixed before scoring: a dominant-plane height band absorbs shallow relief without using the observed PV mask. It is not a verified reconstruction of hidden bare-roof elevations; low equipment and panel-induced geometry remain uncertainty sources. Only the dominant high roof is assessed; lower terraces and secondary service roofs are excluded.

module.source: V1 illustrative design assumptions; not the installed A160 module specifications

limitations: Post-installation 2022 LiDAR and 2025 image annotation. Structural low-relief approximation can suppress small equipment and does not recover verified hidden bare-roof geometry. Not an independent pre-installation study or a maximum-capacity certification.
